valid.code: const map = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } };
valid.name: module-scope const map with inline multi-statement arrow - pre-built, not flagged

valid.code: class X { static map = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
valid.name: static class field map with inline multi-statement arrow - pre-built, not flagged

valid.code: const map = { handler: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } };
valid.name: exempt key name "handler" - not flagged regardless of scope
single-expression arrow body (not a BlockStatement) - not flagged

invalid.code: function build() { return { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: map rebuilt inside a function body on every call - flagged

invalid.code: class X { field = { a: (x) => { let y = x; return y; } }; }
invalid.name: non-static instance field rebuilds per instantiation - flagged
